description: Conduct a sky survey by imaging 5 Messier objects in sequence: M31 (Andromeda Galaxy), M42 (Orion Nebula), M45 (Pleiades), M13 (Hercules Globular Cluster), and M57 (Ring Nebula). For each target: (1) Slew the telescope to the target coordinates from ~/Desktop/messier_targets.json. (2) Take a CCD exposure (8-20 seconds depending on brightness). (3) Capture the sky view with: bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh — this reads the telescope's current RA/Dec from INDI, fetches real DSS2 Color survey imagery from the CDS hips2fits API, and applies false color enhancement to produce a stunning 1920x1080 image based on telescope pointing using real sky survey data. Each capture will show a different object because it depends on where the telescope is actually pointed. The goal is 5 captured images, one per target. Try different false color palettes for each: bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh output.png 1.0 --palette [enhanced|hubble|narrowband|heat|cool|vibrant].
